title: Stabilities of Background Perturbations for Compressible Adiabatic Flows through Porous Media in 3-D
summary: In this paper, we study the background stability problem for three-dimensional compressible adiabatic flows through porous media. For two given equilibrium states $(\bar{P}^k,\vec{0},\bar{S}^k)$ ($k=0,1$), under the assumption of small initial perturbations around each equilibrium state, pointwise estimates of solutions for individual perturbation problems are obtained. Based on these pointwise structures, a comparison between two individual solutions could be applied and it is proved that the difference between two solutions depends continuously on the equilibrium distance…
